source: State well registers: AZ Arizona DWR well registry (Wells55), not cancelled; CA California DWR well completion reports (new wells); ID Idaho DWR well records; MI Michigan EGLE Wellogic water well records; MN Minnesota County Well Index (MDH and Minnesota Geological Survey); NV Nevada DWR well driller reports (new wells); OH Ohio DNR water well logs; OK Oklahoma Water Resources Board groundwater wells; WI Wisconsin DNR high-capacity wells (active sources)

MN.register: Minnesota County Well Index (MDH and Minnesota Geological Survey)
MN.level_kind: static water level (average of recorded measurements)

MI.register: Michigan EGLE Wellogic water well records

WI.where: ACTIVE_SOURCE='Y' AND WATER_USE_SHORT_DESC IN ('Agricultural irrigation','Cranberry irrigation','Berry irrig not cranb','Orchards/nursery irrig','Sod irrigation')

OK.register: Oklahoma Water Resources Board groundwater wells
OK.level_kind: depth to first water at drilling (not a static level)

CA.register: California DWR well completion reports (new wells)

AZ.register: Arizona DWR well registry (Wells55), not cancelled
AZ.where: WATER_USE LIKE '%IRRIGATION%' AND (WELL_CANCELLED IS NULL OR WELL_CANCELLED='N')

NV.register: Nevada DWR well driller reports (new wells)
